name: Bradford Acoustigard
rag_summary:
Bradford Acoustigard is a non-combustible bio-soluble glasswool
insulation supplied in pre-cut batts and rolls, specifically formulated for
acoustic control in commercial steel stud and timber drywall partitions.
Available in densities from 11 kg/m3 to 32 kg/m3 and thicknesses of 50mm, 75mm,
and 90mm (R1.3 to R2.7), it provides high sound transmission loss (Rw 42 to 60+)
and cavity absorption. Manufactured in Australia with up to 65% recycled glass
and certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1, it fits standard 64mm and 92mm studs
snugly without bulging plasterboard linings.
description:

non-combustible glasswool insulation available in partition batts and rolls,

content using biosoluble FBS-1 formulation, it provides sound transmission loss
and cavity absorption in commercial steel stud and timber wall assemblies. It is
non-combustible, low-allergen, and sized to fit standard 64mm and 92mm steel
stud walls without causing plasterboard bulge.

name: Bradford Fibertex
rag_summary:
Bradford
Fibertex is a heavy-duty, non-combustible rockwool (stone wool) board and
blanket range engineered for high-temperature industrial equipment, fire-rated
curtain walls, and acoustic enclosures. Spun from natural volcanic rock and
recycled slag in densities from 60 kg/m3 (Fibertex 350) up to 130 kg/m3
(Fibertex 820), it withstands continuous service temperatures up to 820°C with
minimal thermal shrinkage. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and complying
with ASTM C795 low-chloride standards for stainless steel, it delivers
industrial thermal conservation, personnel protection, and acoustic absorption.
description:
Bradford Fibertex is a range of robust, non-combustible rockwool
(stone wool) industrial insulation boards and blankets engineered for
high-temperature and fire-critical applications. Manufactured by spinning molten
natural basalt rock and recycled slag into fine inorganic fibres bonded with a
thermosetting resin, Fibertex operates continuously at service temperatures
from 350°C up to 820°C with minimal shrinkage. It provides thermal conservation,
fire protection, condensation prevention, and acoustic absorption for industrial
process vessels, tanks, furnaces, fire-rated curtain walls, and building
envelopes.

name: Bradford Fire Protection - Damper Strip
rag_summary:
Bradford Fire
Protection - Damper Strip (Fireseal Fire Damper Strip / Fibertex 820 Damper
Strip) is a specialized 13mm thick, high-density (110 kg/m³) rockwool insulation
strip engineered for passive fire stopping. Specifically designed to seal the
perimeter clearance between fire dampers and fire-rated walls or floor slabs, it
also provides horizontal joint fire protection in Hebel and Speedpanel systems.
It resists shrinkage at temperatures up to 820°C, complies with AS 1530.1 as
non-combustible, and must be installed under a minimum 15% compression to
achieve rated fire resistance levels (up to -/240/240).
description:
Bradford Fireseal Fire Damper Strip is a high-density,
non-combustible rockwool insulation material specifically formulated to provide
passive fire protection around fire dampers, service penetrations, and control
joints. Manufactured by spinning molten natural rock and recycled blast furnace
slag into bio-soluble fibres bonded with a thermosetting resin, it offers
remarkable resistance to shrinkage at extreme fire temperatures up to 820°C. It
is installed compressed in the gap between a fire damper sleeve and the
fire-rated wall or floor structure.

name: Bradford Fire Protection - Filler
rag_summary:
Bradford Fire Protection - Filler (Fireseal Party
Wall Batten Fillers) are pre-formed non-combustible rockwool inserts
measuring 100mm x 40mm, designed specifically to plug continuous metal roof and
ceiling battens passing over party walls in Class 1 buildings. They prevent
fire, embers, and hot gases from channeling through hollow metal batten cavities
across inter-tenancy boundaries. Certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1 and
tested to AS/NZS 1530.3, they are a critical Deemed-to-Satisfy component of
compliant multi-residential passive fire containment systems.
description:
Bradford Fire Protection - Filler (Fireseal Party Wall Batten
Fillers) are pre-cut, non-combustible rockwool insulation inserts designed to
seal hollow metal roof and ceiling battens crossing fire-rated separating walls
in Class 1 residential buildings. Manufactured from high-temperature rockwool,
these inserts fill the 40mm metal batten profile to prevent flame, hot gases,
and embers from bypassing the fire compartment boundary. They are purpose-shaped
to compress snugly inside steel batten profiles to meet NCC and BCA
Deemed-to-Satisfy requirements.

resin, the 75mm thick blanket or batts are installed under 10-15% compression
beneath corrugated or trapezoidal metal roof profiles. It blocks the passage of
fire, smoke, and burning embers between adjoining tenancies in Class 1 buildings
and meets BAL-FZ bushfire conditions.

BL-IT, product code 106703) is a specialized Light Duty, Class 4
vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered for open-joint rainscreen facades.

temperatures up to 120°C, it is rated for facades with up to 30% open joint

UV durability for facades with up to 30% open area, it comes equipped with an
integrated adhesive tape system with release liners for fast, airtight lap
sealing. It permits water vapour to escape from building interiors while forming
a continuous weather and air barrier behind architectural claddings.

rag_summary:
Bradford
Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Hightack Tape (product code 155170) is a premium 60mm
x 25m single-sided adhesive tape featuring an aggressive, solvent-free acrylic
adhesive on a flexible polyolefin carrier. Engineered specifically for sealing
laps and penetrations on Enviroseal vapour-permeable membranes and Thermoseal
sarking, it creates airtight and watertight barriers across diverse construction
substrates including timber, steel, PVC, and foil. Operating reliably from -40°C
to +80°C with zero chlorine or formaldehyde, it is essential for achieving
blower-door airtightness and weather protection in modern energy-efficient
envelopes.
description:

adhesive sealing tape featuring a flexible synthetic carrier designed to create
durable air and watertight seals on construction membranes. Formulated with a
solvent-free, high-grab adhesive, it adheres aggressively to vapour-permeable
wall wraps, aluminium foil sarking, timber, steel, plastics, and masonry. It is
specifically engineered to seal overlaps, penetrations, window flashings, and
pipe junctions to ensure the integrity of the building envelope.

high puncture resistance against construction traffic and high winds. When
installed adjacent to an internal or external air cavity, its reflective
aluminium facing generates thermal air-gap R-values while forming a Class 1/2
vapour barrier and liquid water barrier.

name: DCTech Acoustic Barrier
primary_function: Acoustic Barrier insulation product from DCTech.
rag_summary:
DCTech Acoustic Barrier (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a
high-density, visco-elastic synthetic soundproofing membrane distributed in
Australia by DCTech. Formulated from asphalt-free polymers at 5.0 kg/m²
(Tecsound 50, 2.5mm) and 7.0 kg/m² (Tecsound 70 / SY 70, 3.5mm), it provides an
Rw of up to 30 dB as a single layer without adding significant wall or ceiling
thickness. Available with a self-adhesive backing (SY) or composite felt (2FT),
it dampens airborne noise, aircraft flyover rumble, and metal roof rain drumming
across walls, ceilings, floors, and building services. Rated Euroclass B, s2,
d0, non-toxic, and flexible down to -20°C, it is an advanced acoustic damping
membrane for high-performance building envelopes.
description:
DCTech Acoustic Barrier (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a
high-density, polymer-based asphalt-free synthetic soundproofing membrane
engineered to deliver exceptional airborne and impact noise reduction without
increasing structural thickness. Highly visco-elastic and adaptable, it acts as
an acoustic damping mass that breaks up structural resonance in drywall
partitions, ceilings, timber floors, metal roofs, and building service
enclosures. Distributed in Australia by DCTech, it is available in standard,
self-adhesive (SY), and composite felt (2FT) configurations.

name: DCTech Dct Xps Ga
rag_summary:
DCTech DCT XPS GA (DCT XPS GA 300) is a rigid,
high-compressive-strength (300 kPa) extruded polystyrene insulation board
engineered for under-slab, inverted flat roof (IRMA), green roof, and cavity
wall applications. Featuring a 100% closed-cell structure with near-zero water
absorption (<0.3%) and tongue-and-groove edges, it delivers durable thermal
performance (conductivity 0.028-0.034 W/m·K) that resists compression creep,
ground moisture, and freeze-thaw degradation over a 50-year design life.
Manufactured with zero ODP and CFC/HCFC-free blowing agents, it provides
high-load thermal buffering beneath concrete slabs and protected membrane
roofs.
description:
DCT XPS GA 300 is a closed-cell, high-compressive-strength,
low-moisture-absorption extruded polystyrene (XPS) general application rigid
insulation board for roofs, walls, and floors in commercial and residential
buildings. Manufactured in accordance with EN 13164 with zero Ozone Depletion
Potential (ODP) and CFC/HCFC-free blowing agents, it offers exceptional
compressive strength of 300 kPa and long-term dimensional stability. It
maintains superior thermal performance even under extreme conditions of
compressive loading, ground moisture, and freeze-thaw cycles.

name: Ecowool Condenshield Roof Blanket
rag_summary:
Ecowool CondenShield is a lightweight, reflective
foil-faced glass mineral wool roofing blanket manufactured by PGF Insulation.
Available in thermal ratings from R1.3 to R3.7 (60mm to 150mm thick) in 1200mm
wide rolls, it is installed under residential and commercial metal or tile roofs
to manage condensation, block radiant heat, and dampen rain impact drumming
noise. Built with SensiTouch low-VOC bio-soluble glasswool and nearly 80%
recycled glass, its non-combustible core (AS 1530.1) and low-flammability foil
facing (Index ≤ 5) make it suitable for bushfire zones up to BAL-40.
description:
Ecowool CondenShield is a lightweight, reflective foil-faced
glass mineral wool insulation blanket designed for fire safety, thermal
performance, condensation control, and acoustic absorption in metal and tile
roof systems. Manufactured with SensiTouch technology using nearly 80% recycled
glass and a natural anti-formaldehyde binder, it significantly slows heat
transfer into and out of the building while damping outside rain noise. The
reflective foil facing acts as a barrier against radiant heat and prevents
condensation accumulation beneath roof cladding.

primary_function: Foil-faced glasswool building blanket for metal roofs and suitable wall systems, providing thermal insulation, condensation control and rain-noise reduction.
rag_summary:
Fletcher Permastop Building Blanket is a reflective glasswool insulation
blanket factory-bonded to a Sisalation foil facing with a 150mm overlap flap.
Available in ratings from R1.3 to R3.6 (55mm to 130mm thick) in 1200mm wide
rolls, it is installed under residential and commercial metal roofs to prevent
condensation dripping, reflect radiant heat, and dampen rain drumming noise.
Built with non-combustible glasswool (AS 1530.1) and low-flammability foil
(Index ≤ 5, BAL-40 compliant), it provides a complete thermal, acoustic, and
vapour barrier for metal-clad structures.

blanket factory-laminated with Sisalation reflective foil facing, designed for

bio-soluble glasswool bonded to light, medium, or heavy-duty aluminium foil with

impact drumming noise. Available in R-values from R1.3 to R3.6 (including an
industry-leading R3.6 in 130mm), it satisfies NCC requirements and bushfire
ratings up to BAL-40.

name: Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap
primary_function: Vapour-permeable water-barrier wall wrap for suitable cladding and climate-zone applications.
rag_summary:
Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap is a Class 4
vapour-permeable, Light Duty pliable building membrane designed for residential
timber and steel-framed walls. Manufactured from non-woven spunbond polyolefin
with a microporous breathable film, it prevents liquid water, drafts, and dust
penetration while permitting internal water vapour to escape. Available
in 1350mm and 1500mm widths with up to 30-day (VP4-30) or 90-day (VP4-90) UV
resistance and a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (BAL 0-FZ compliant), it prevents mould
and rot behind lightweight claddings and brick veneer.
description:
Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap is a lightweight,
flexible Class 4 vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered for residential timber
and steel-framed homes, particularly in temperate and colder climate zones
(Zones 2 to 8). Constructed from a micro-porous breathable film laminated
between two layers of mould- and shrink-resistant spun-bonded polyolefin, it
allows internal moisture vapour to escape while acting as a barrier to liquid
water, wind, and dust. Available with up to 30 days (VP4-30) or 90 days (VP4-90)
UV resistance, it protects the structural frame and maximizes bulk insulation
efficiency.

primary_function: Vapour-permeable roof sarking for condensation management beneath suitable roof cladding.
rag_summary:
Sisalation Vapawrap Vapour Permeable
Metal Roof is a Medium Duty, Class 4 vapour-permeable synthetic roof sarking
membrane developed specifically for profiled metal roofs. Fabricated from
spun-bonded polyolefin non-woven layers sandwiching a microporous core, it
delivers outstanding heat-shrink resistance to remain taut beneath hot metal
decks. Allowing moisture vapour to vent freely while preventing water leaks and
drafts, it complies with AS/NZS 4200.1, AS 1530.2 (Flammability Index ≤ 5), and
AS 3959 (up to BAL-40) to mitigate roof condensation.
description:
Sisalation Vapawrap Vapour Permeable Metal Roof is a synthetic,
Class 4 vapour-permeable roof sarking membrane specifically engineered for use
under residential and commercial metal roof claddings. Formulated with a
microporous water-resistant film sandwiched between two layers of mould- and
shrink-resistant spun-bonded polyolefin, it provides superior heat shrink
resistance compared to traditional polymer-weave membranes under hot metal
decks. It allows water vapour to escape from roof cavities while functioning as
an air and liquid water barrier that safely drains condensation into gutters.

anchors. By creating a broad clamping surface, they prevent fastener heads from
pulling through the aluminum foil facing during wind load or structural
vibration.

name: Foilboard Floor Saddles
rag_summary:
Foilboard Floor Saddles are
galvanized spring-steel support brackets designed to cradle Foilboard panels
between timber joists in new suspended floor construction. Engineered in 100mm
and 130mm depths to accommodate panels from 10mm to 50mm, they automatically
guarantee the critical 20mm reflective airspace required beneath floorboards to
achieve rated underfloor R-values. Installed from above before flooring is laid,
they hold panels permanently in place without sagging, eliminating the need for
strapping or adhesives.
description:
Foilboard Floor Saddles are specialized galvanized steel support
brackets engineered specifically for installing Foilboard rigid insulation
boards between timber floor joists. Designed with pre-set drops, they
automatically create and maintain the required 20mm+ still reflective airspace
between the insulation panel and the underside of floorboards. Suitable for new
suspended floor construction or retrofits from above, they hold Foilboard panels
securely in place without compression, preventing sagging over the life of the
building.

rag_summary:
The
Foilboard Garage Door Kit is an all-in-one DIY insulation system designed to
insulate residential sectional panel-lift metal garage doors. Comprising
lightweight, pre-cut Foilboard Green panels (10mm or 15mm), heavy-duty mounting

to lower garage temperatures by up to 10°C in summer. Adding only 4-6 kg to the
entire door, it preserves automatic door opener balance while providing thermal,
acoustic, and anti-vibration benefits backed by a 25-year warranty.

performance warranty.

across residential and commercial buildings.

name: Foilboard Spacer Blocks
rag_summary:
Foilboard Spacer Blocks are
pre-cut 20mm and 25mm fire-retardant EPS blocks designed to maintain a
consistent, uncompressed reflective airspace between Foilboard panels and
adjacent building claddings. By establishing the required still air cavity, they
ensure Foilboard systems achieve their certified total thermal R-values while
preventing panels from flexing under wind loads. Moisture-proof and rot-proof,
they provide a reliable, low-cost solution for cavity depth management across
framed walls and ceilings.
description:
Foilboard Spacer Blocks are pre-cut expanded polystyrene (EPS)
blocks designed to maintain a consistent, non-collapsible reflective airspace
between Foilboard insulation panels and external wall claddings or internal
linings. By establishing a guaranteed 20mm or 25mm still air cavity adjacent to
the reflective aluminum foil face, they ensure the assembly achieves its rated
total thermal R-value. Adhered or mechanically fixed between framing members,
they prevent panels from flexing, dislocating, or touching adjacent cladding
under wind loads.

rag_summary:

galvanized timber-fixing fasteners equipped with wide washer heads designed to
secure 10mm to 25mm Foilboard panels to timber framing. By spreading mechanical
holding loads over an enlarged surface area, they prevent nail heads from
tearing through the aluminum facing or crushing the EPS core. Engineered for
rapid hammer-in fixing on residential timber-stud walls and ceilings, they
provide durable mechanical retention without compromising panel performance.
description:

plastic washer plates, engineered to secure Foilboard panels to timber framing
without puncturing or compressing the core. By spreading the fastening load
across a wide surface area, they prevent fastener pull-through under wind
suction and vibration. They provide a fast, secure fixing method for residential
timber-stud walls, raked ceilings, and shed framing.

name: Misc Rhino Breathable Membrane
rag_summary:
Rhino Breathable Membrane (Rhino Wrap Breather) is
a Class 4 vapour-permeable, Light Duty pliable building membrane manufactured
from non-woven spunbonded polyolefin with a microporous core. Designed for
timber and steel-framed external walls, it allows interior moisture vapour to
diffuse freely while acting as a barrier against wind-driven rain, dust, and
draughts. Compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1:2017 and possessing a Flammability Index
≤ 5 (BAL-40 suitable), it mitigates condensation and mould in residential and
commercial wall assemblies.
description:
Rhino Wrap Breather is a Class 4 vapour permeable, Light Duty
flexible building membrane engineered for external walls. Manufactured by
laminating a microporous film between two layers of spunbonded non-woven
polyolefin, it allows internal water vapour to escape while acting as an
effective barrier to liquid water, draughts, and dust. It is designed to reduce
the risk of interstitial condensation in residential and commercial timber and
steel-framed wall assemblies.

ventilation louvres installed on exterior gable end walls to cross-ventilate

primary_function: Drainage / Ventilation insulation product from Proctor.
rag_summary:
ProctorGeo IRMA is a heavy-duty, water-vapour permeable non-woven geotextile
engineered specifically as a filter, separation, and water-deflecting layer for
Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies (IRMA). Laid loose directly over extruded
polystyrene (XPS) insulation beneath gravel ballast or pavers, its virgin

preserve the thermal performance of flat concrete roofs.

name: ProctorWrap Plasti-Grip Washers
rag_summary:
ProctorWrap Plasti-Grip Washers are 45mm
diameter polypropylene fixing discs engineered to secure building wraps and
rigid insulation boards to timber and steel framing. Designed with a flat base,
flexible perimeter, and 5mm deep cupped head, they distribute clamping loads

description:

airtight mechanical anchor for high-wind building envelopes.
